description:
Sturdy Frame

Mountain bike with high carbon steel frame that has good durability; It is strong and shock resistant; Meanwhile the carbon steel is relatively easy and safe to handle

18-Speed Gearing

18-speed derailleur that facilitate quick and precise gear changes, allowing for smooth transitions during rides ensure total control; It can be adapted to various terrains, such as forestroad, gravel, grass, mountain terrain

Designed For Women

The frame design is simpler to maintain for women, the low and smooth frame makes the riding easier; Double wall aluminum tires ensure safety when you ride faster in the city or on terrain, and be more efficient when pedaling

Reliable Brake

Disc brakes are more responsive and quicker braking, providing excellent braking power in all weather conditions for safety and control

Size Guide

This is suitable for person 5'- 6' tall and over 12 years old; Mountain bike is 85% pre-assembled and easy to assemble within 25 minutes; The delivery box include free installation tools, pedals and kickstand

Elevate your trail game with the Hiland Gamille 3.0. Featuring a 18-speed Shimano drivetrain, lightweight aluminum frame, and hydraulic disc brakes for pro-level control.
